thread:
alex: Heads up — customer (acct: acme-co) reporting intermittent 401s on streaming SSE to /v1/stream. They included two request ids: req_6C2b4 and req_6C2b8. Happens ~5–10s after connect, usually during longer streams.

dawn: Can you paste the exact curl they ran? any proxy or LB in front? :thinking_face:

alex: Their original curl (redacted token):
```
curl -i -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXX' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-4o-mini'
```

chris: Two quick things: 1) SSE + curl tends to pick HTTP/2 by default which can behave oddly for long-lived connections; force HTTP/1.1. 2) add --no-buffer and explicit keep-alive/cache headers. Suggested repro: 
```
curl -v --http1.1 --no-buffer \
  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Connection: keep-alive' \
  -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' \
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-4o-mini&stream=true'
```

alex: Asked customer to run that and provide --trace-ascii output (or curl --trace). Also asked for the full response headers — we specifically need x-rw-request-id / x-rw-trace-id and any WWW-Authenticate payload.

dawn: I'll collect a debug bundle: client curl trace, client-side chunk timings, server request ids you called out, and whether they're behind a corporate proxy (host + port). Also ask them to include system time and timezone to rule out skew.

sre-bot: Deploy-bot: streaming runtime v1.12.4 rolled out to us-west at 2025-11-02T08:12:00Z — watch for transient auth edgecases.

chris: If they still get 401, capture the response body and headers exactly. 401 with code 'TokenExpired' points to token TTL/rotation. 401 with 'InvalidSignature' or no WWW-Authenticate = proxy stripping/rewriting auth. If we see a server trace id (x-rw-trace-id), attach to the bundle.

alex: Customer ran the recommended repro. They uploaded traces: req_6C2b4 produced x-rw-trace-id tr_9ab3, 401 after ~8s. Attached curl --trace-ascii log and tcpdump snippet.

dawn: Forwarding bundle to eng-oncall with checklist: repro curl (http1.1 + no-buffer), redacted token, curl trace, client chunk timing csv, proxy headers, server trace id (tr_9ab3), and timestamps (client + server).

alex: Opening support ticket now and will link ticket id here when created. Thanks — will follow up after eng triage. :thumbsup:
